description: This file defines a custom matcher 'HaveFieldMatcher' for the Gomega testing framework, used to verify the presence and value of a specific field within a struct during testing.

classes.name: HaveFieldMatcher
classes.description: A matcher that checks for a specific field's value within a struct, supporting nested fields and method calls.

methods.name: expectedMatcher
methods.description: Returns the matcher used to compare the extracted field value, defaulting to an equality matcher if none is specified.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Extracts the specified field from the actual object and applies the expected matcher to verify its value.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a failure message if the field extraction or matching fails.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a negated failure message if the field matches when it should not.
